scripts.build:all: npm run build -w www && npm run build -w docs && rm -rf apps/www/dist/docs && cp -r apps/docs/.vitepress/dist apps/www/dist/docs
scripts.summary: find . \( -name 'node_modules' -o -name 'dist' -o -name '.git' -o -name '.wrangler' -o -name 'assets' \) -prune -o -type f \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.json' -o -name '*.html' -o -name '*.css' -o -name '*.toml' \) -not -name 'package-lock.json' -not -name '*.min.js' -not -name '*.map' -print0 | xargs -0 -I {} sh -c 'echo "FILE: {}"; cat "{}"; echo "\n---"' > project_summary.txt
